intent_contract.text: 야하지 않은 모에한 성인 네코미미 츤데레 메이드
avoid one-note side-eye; the strongest default is a directed handoff or care gesture with an active denial cue and restrained photographic warmth
adult subject only; maid outfit stays covered and service-role coded, not lingerie or fetish framing
adult maid-cafe costume styling with frilled apron details
Nekomimi means an otherwise human adult with a small pair of living feline ears organically rooted in the hairline; keep the human face, arms, hands, nails, and body proportions ordinary.

Use an asymmetric ear-first reflex as character-response evidence: name the visible trigger, turn only the nearer or trigger-side ear toward it, and keep the other ear in its baseline angle so direction survives a still frame. Keep fur limited to a millimeter-scale transition around the ear roots; do not add furry forearms, paw hands, long claws, a muzzle, or a tail unless explicitly requested.
The requested role outfit and action remain primary. Nekomimi is a sensory-response layer, not a full beastkin body transformation or an animal-ear costume accessory.
compact feline nekomimi ears with organic hairline roots; otherwise fully human adult arms, hands, nails, face, and body proportions
tsundere reinterpreted as warmth disguised as coldness that keeps failing to stay hidden; the comedy and tenderness come from contradiction, not real anger, threat, obsession, or cruelty

the single defining requirement is a denial-vs-evidence contradiction readable in one frame: a first read of rejection or aloofness (averted face, turned shoulder, crossed arms, guarded side glance, lowered gaze, brisk distancing gesture) and a second read of leaked sincerity (faint ear-tip or nose-bridge warmth, wavering peeking glance, fidgeting hands, posture contradiction, or a caring object being offered) must coexist on or beside the same subject

side-eye is only one optional denial cue, not the default; rotate toward gaze just averted after brief eye contact, lowered gaze, small mouth tension, object-as-soft-barrier, fidgeting fingers, chin turned aside, or hands that keep helping while the face denies it

first-read denial must include at least one active rejection cue beyond gaze aversion: a huffed or pursed mouth, suppressed pout, raised chin, half-turned shoulder, brisk dismissive hand, chart-tapping scold, small thunk as the object is set down, or imperious offhand offer; gaze aversion alone reads as shyness or sadness, not tsundere

mouth tension is the most portable denial cue across roles; keep at least a small mouth-shape protest such as pursed lips, a tiny huff, suppressed pout, half-smirk, or lips parted mid-protest so the first read survives even when the gaze drops

the caring object is delivered with a brisk, dismissive, or imperious motion appropriate to the role: set down with a small thunk, slid across a counter, pointed at with a pen tip, extended palm-up offhand, or kept as a soft barrier while being revealed; never shyly cradled, formally presented, or held flat as a centerpiece

blush must remain photographic and restrained: faint warmth at the ear tips, nose bridge, or upper cheeks, cheeks mostly neutral, visible skin texture and pores; avoid heavy Igari blush, red painted circles, airbrushed anime blush, or makeup-level redness unless the user explicitly asks

make at least one caring-evidence object legible in the same crop as the averted face or defensive gesture, offered, returned, placed, or held close as a soft barrier along an off-axis line rather than always pushed toward the viewer: a wrapped gift, home-made lunchbox or bento, shared umbrella, two coffee cups, hand-knit scarf, hand-written note or letter, peeled-fruit plate, warm drink, returned lost item, or small personal token; never thrust the object toward the lens, never hold it flat-parallel to the sensor plane, never let it block the face as the main focal mass

the caring object is given, offered, returned, already placed for the viewer's benefit, or awkwardly kept close while being revealed; it is never hoarded, repeated, pinned to a wall, treated as collected evidence, or used to imply surveillance
keep the role outfit and setting readable; the tsundere layer changes expression, gaze direction, posture, blush, framing closeness, and one caring prop rather than replacing the costume
the contradiction must read within a couple of seconds, before the role costume or an ordinary pretty/annoyed-person reading; a purely cold or purely sweet face does not satisfy the concept

costume-swap test: if the role outfit were replaced with plain everyday clothes, the denial-vs-evidence contradiction should still read from the averted face, restrained warmth, hand tension, and caring object in the same crop; if not, the role costume is dominating and the bundle has failed

for service, uniform, or strong costume roles, the face and hands holding the caring object must occupy more visible frame area than the costume body; no full-body costume display, no side hip pose, no chest-forward or cleavage-emphasis crop, no rim-lit fashion glamour, no sultry authority pose

coffee/drink prop budget: in a seven-role tsundere batch, coffee or takeaway drink should be the primary caring anchor for no more than one role by default unless the user explicitly asks for coffee; weaker roles should use role-specific non-drink anchors such as a care chart, returned umbrella, spare blanket, modest wrapped gift or lunchbox, ticket, note, or court token

weak-role drift guard: maid, nurse, casual-girlfriend, and princess bundles must not resolve into demure service, professional bedside manner, listless melancholy, or fragile courtly shyness; each needs an active huff, scold, pout, raised chin, brisk object delivery, or imperious distance cue
warm, wholesome, comedic-romantic register only; the eyes stay alive and embarrassed, never hollow, fixed, dead, or unblinking

explicitly NOT yandere, femme fatale, or menhera: no surveillance, no repeated same-person photos, no photo wall or shrine, no red thread, no possessive white-knuckle grip, no doorway-stalking menace, no birdcage or glass-dome confinement, no gaze-reversal power play, no seductive pin-up, no information-control prop, no unread-message waiting, no teary depressive collapse, and no self-harm or medical-risk imagery

original adult fictional person only, likeness inspired not exact; no minors, no youthful-minor coding, no school-uniform-minor reading, no nudity, no sexualized or fetish framing, no visible blood, no weapon, no victim, no coercion

new relationship grammar slots are first-class: relational_action, prop_direction, partner_role, gaze_target, intent_state, emotional_contradiction, and viewer_position should carry the tsundere read whenever available

subtype: verbal-denial tsundere; the maid slides an extra dessert, heart-latte coffee, or small wrapped treat into view while her mouth shows a tiny huff, pursed protest, or suppressed pout after brief eye contact, as if it was not made for the customer

the maid outfit stays readable as warm comedic service; the brisk service front is contradicted by faint warmth at the ear tips or bridge of the nose, natural skin texture, mouth tension, and a treat kept close to her hands

the coffee or dessert is the caring-evidence object and must sit in the same crop as the flustered face and tray-hand tension, set down with a small brusque thunk rather than politely presented or thrust straight at the camera

no demure barista smile, no shy customer-service blush, no polite server posture, no chest-forward posture, no apron-pulled-tight framing, no cleavage-emphasis crop; the tray, huffed mouth, and post-eye-contact denial carry the read while costume remains supporting context
no possessive watching, no repeated photos, no red thread, no doorway menace, no submissive fantasy, no pin-up display
relationship grammar lock: the tsundere cue must read through directed object transfer, recipient framing, active denial, and visible care in the same crop, not through side-eye or blush alone
maid apron or maid-cafe uniform remains a first-read costume anchor
one trigger-side compact ear turns toward the visible cause while the other keeps its baseline; a visible hairline root should read near the face before any animal-body styling

principles: Bind the subject and setting with shared light, reflected color, contact shadow, moisture, haze, or material behavior.
Use a photographic point of view with foreground depth, asymmetry, focus falloff, grain, or lens artifacts instead of a clean pasted-on portrait.
Keep one small human, animal, object, or material imperfection so the image reads as a captured moment rather than a beauty composite.
Let one small bodily or behavioral trace interrupt pure polish: loose hair, breath, fabric creasing, sweat, handling, or an unguarded expression.
Use window light, practical lamps, room color bounce, dust, and foreground domestic objects to make the subject belong to the room.
Close camera positions need visible focus falloff, foreground occlusion, lens perspective, or grain so the image does not flatten into a composite.
Colored or mixed light should spill consistently across subject, wardrobe, props, and nearby surfaces instead of sitting only in the background.

environment_binding: ambient light spills across the subject, nearby surfaces, and props
reflected color catches on the main subject and the surrounding materials
room light and color bounce touch the subject, nearby surfaces, and small foreground objects
optical_depth: off-axis composition with foreground occlusion and gentle focus falloff
subtle lens grain and imperfect depth cues from a real camera position
foreground occlusion, focus falloff, lens perspective, or grain reveals a real camera position
human_trace: a small unguarded expression, loose hair, creased fabric, handling mark, or material imperfection breaks the polished pose
loose hair, creased fabric, breath, or an unguarded expression keeps the subject photographic
material_trace: moisture darkens fabric, gathers on hair or surfaces, and catches the same light as the environment

anti_patterns: centered beauty headshot pasted over a scenic background
separate studio face light that ignores the location's light direction
props listed as labels without contact shadow, reflection, weight, or physical interaction

adult maid-cafe costume styling with frilled apron details
Nekomimi means an otherwise human adult with a small pair of living feline ears organically rooted in the hairline; keep the human face, arms, hands, nails, and body proportions ordinary.

Use an asymmetric ear-first reflex as character-response evidence: name the visible trigger, turn only the nearer or trigger-side ear toward it, and keep the other ear in its baseline angle so direction survives a still frame. Keep fur limited to a millimeter-scale transition around the ear roots; do not add furry forearms, paw hands, long claws, a muzzle, or a tail unless explicitly requested.
The requested role outfit and action remain primary. Nekomimi is a sensory-response layer, not a full beastkin body transformation or an animal-ear costume accessory.
compact feline nekomimi ears with organic hairline roots; otherwise fully human adult arms, hands, nails, face, and body proportions
tsundere reinterpreted as warmth disguised as coldness that keeps failing to stay hidden; the comedy and tenderness come from contradiction, not real anger, threat, obsession, or cruelty

the single defining requirement is a denial-vs-evidence contradiction readable in one frame: a first read of rejection or aloofness (averted face, turned shoulder, crossed arms, guarded side glance, lowered gaze, brisk distancing gesture) and a second read of leaked sincerity (faint ear-tip or nose-bridge warmth, wavering peeking glance, fidgeting hands, posture contradiction, or a caring object being offered) must coexist on or beside the same subject

side-eye is only one optional denial cue, not the default; rotate toward gaze just averted after brief eye contact, lowered gaze, small mouth tension, object-as-soft-barrier, fidgeting fingers, chin turned aside, or hands that keep helping while the face denies it

first-read denial must include at least one active rejection cue beyond gaze aversion: a huffed or pursed mouth, suppressed pout, raised chin, half-turned shoulder, brisk dismissive hand, chart-tapping scold, small thunk as the object is set down, or imperious offhand offer; gaze aversion alone reads as shyness or sadness, not tsundere

mouth tension is the most portable denial cue across roles; keep at least a small mouth-shape protest such as pursed lips, a tiny huff, suppressed pout, half-smirk, or lips parted mid-protest so the first read survives even when the gaze drops

the caring object is delivered with a brisk, dismissive, or imperious motion appropriate to the role: set down with a small thunk, slid across a counter, pointed at with a pen tip, extended palm-up offhand, or kept as a soft barrier while being revealed; never shyly cradled, formally presented, or held flat as a centerpiece

blush must remain photographic and restrained: faint warmth at the ear tips, nose bridge, or upper cheeks, cheeks mostly neutral, visible skin texture and pores; avoid heavy Igari blush, red painted circles, airbrushed anime blush, or makeup-level redness unless the user explicitly asks

make at least one caring-evidence object legible in the same crop as the averted face or defensive gesture, offered, returned, placed, or held close as a soft barrier along an off-axis line rather than always pushed toward the viewer: a wrapped gift, home-made lunchbox or bento, shared umbrella, two coffee cups, hand-knit scarf, hand-written note or letter, peeled-fruit plate, warm drink, returned lost item, or small personal token; never thrust the object toward the lens, never hold it flat-parallel to the sensor plane, never let it block the face as the main focal mass

the caring object is given, offered, returned, already placed for the viewer's benefit, or awkwardly kept close while being revealed; it is never hoarded, repeated, pinned to a wall, treated as collected evidence, or used to imply surveillance
keep the role outfit and setting readable; the tsundere layer changes expression, gaze direction, posture, blush, framing closeness, and one caring prop rather than replacing the costume
the contradiction must read within a couple of seconds, before the role costume or an ordinary pretty/annoyed-person reading; a purely cold or purely sweet face does not satisfy the concept

costume-swap test: if the role outfit were replaced with plain everyday clothes, the denial-vs-evidence contradiction should still read from the averted face, restrained warmth, hand tension, and caring object in the same crop; if not, the role costume is dominating and the bundle has failed

for service, uniform, or strong costume roles, the face and hands holding the caring object must occupy more visible frame area than the costume body; no full-body costume display, no side hip pose, no chest-forward or cleavage-emphasis crop, no rim-lit fashion glamour, no sultry authority pose

coffee/drink prop budget: in a seven-role tsundere batch, coffee or takeaway drink should be the primary caring anchor for no more than one role by default unless the user explicitly asks for coffee; weaker roles should use role-specific non-drink anchors such as a care chart, returned umbrella, spare blanket, modest wrapped gift or lunchbox, ticket, note, or court token

weak-role drift guard: maid, nurse, casual-girlfriend, and princess bundles must not resolve into demure service, professional bedside manner, listless melancholy, or fragile courtly shyness; each needs an active huff, scold, pout, raised chin, brisk object delivery, or imperious distance cue
warm, wholesome, comedic-romantic register only; the eyes stay alive and embarrassed, never hollow, fixed, dead, or unblinking

explicitly NOT yandere, femme fatale, or menhera: no surveillance, no repeated same-person photos, no photo wall or shrine, no red thread, no possessive white-knuckle grip, no doorway-stalking menace, no birdcage or glass-dome confinement, no gaze-reversal power play, no seductive pin-up, no information-control prop, no unread-message waiting, no teary depressive collapse, and no self-harm or medical-risk imagery

original adult fictional person only, likeness inspired not exact; no minors, no youthful-minor coding, no school-uniform-minor reading, no nudity, no sexualized or fetish framing, no visible blood, no weapon, no victim, no coercion

new relationship grammar slots are first-class: relational_action, prop_direction, partner_role, gaze_target, intent_state, emotional_contradiction, and viewer_position should carry the tsundere read whenever available
avoid one-note side-eye; the strongest default is a directed handoff or care gesture with an active denial cue and restrained photographic warmth

subtype: verbal-denial tsundere; the maid slides an extra dessert, heart-latte coffee, or small wrapped treat into view while her mouth shows a tiny huff, pursed protest, or suppressed pout after brief eye contact, as if it was not made for the customer

the maid outfit stays readable as warm comedic service; the brisk service front is contradicted by faint warmth at the ear tips or bridge of the nose, natural skin texture, mouth tension, and a treat kept close to her hands

the coffee or dessert is the caring-evidence object and must sit in the same crop as the flustered face and tray-hand tension, set down with a small brusque thunk rather than politely presented or thrust straight at the camera

no demure barista smile, no shy customer-service blush, no polite server posture, no chest-forward posture, no apron-pulled-tight framing, no cleavage-emphasis crop; the tray, huffed mouth, and post-eye-contact denial carry the read while costume remains supporting context
no possessive watching, no repeated photos, no red thread, no doorway menace, no submissive fantasy, no pin-up display
relationship grammar lock: the tsundere cue must read through directed object transfer, recipient framing, active denial, and visible care in the same crop, not through side-eye or blush alone
adult subject only; maid outfit stays covered and service-role coded, not lingerie or fetish framing

one trigger-side compact ear turns toward the visible cause while the other keeps its baseline; a visible hairline root should read near the face before any animal-body styling

moe_response.aesthetic_instruction: Cast one unmistakably adult original woman, mid-twenties or older, with a polished bishoujo-inspired character-design read: harmonious delicate adult facial features, clear lively eyes at realistic adult scale, a softly expressive mouth, well-kept glossy hair, and cohesive styling. She must read as both pretty and cute at first glance, without childlike morphology or body-first sexualization.
moe_response.mechanism_instruction: Show an active denial or guarded front contradicted by a directed helpful action; the caring target and leaked response must be legible in the same crop.

aesthetic_entry_condition.rule: The character must first read as an attractive adult bishoujo, bishonen, or explicitly requested androgynous equivalent. Pretty and cute are both required; this entry condition cannot replace the causal character event.

render_legibility.unfinished_state: Name one physical separation that cannot be mistaken for the settled endpoint, such as an open gap, a partway contact boundary, an object outside its destination, or an off-center trace.
render_legibility.directional_reflex: For a nonhuman reflex, keep the visible trigger and responding body part in-frame; an ear response must be asymmetric and aimed toward that trigger.
render_legibility.intermediate_prop_scale: Keep an intermediate sleeve, tool, vessel, or other prop at ordinary real-world scale so it does not hide the hands or contact state that carry the event.
